name: modern-web-guidance-src
one_liner: A rulebook that teaches AI coding assistants the modern, correct way to build websites so they stop writing old-fashioned, bloated code.
buyer: A web agency's engineering lead who wants every AI-assisted project to default to modern, accessible code instead of outdated patterns.
business_use_cases: A web agency installs it so every AI-assisted client site defaults to modern CSS/JS instead of legacy patterns, cutting QA and cleanup time.
A performance consultant runs the legacy-scan command on a prospect's site before quoting a modernization project.
A coding bootcamp uses the curated guides as current teaching material instead of stale blog tutorials.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'legacy code scan + modernization report' service for small business websites using the CLI's scan output

steal_this: Run the legacy-scan CLI against a handful of local businesses' outdated websites and sell them a flat-fee modernization report.
